description: Intent taxonomy for the Google Ads AI support assistant. Covers ad disapproval scenarios derived from the Editorial and Technical Requirements policy (ADS-EDT-001).

intents.label: Ad Disapproved — Gimmicky Symbols
intents.description: Advertiser's ad was disapproved because the ad text uses non-standard punctuation, symbols, or stylized spelling.
example_phrases: My ad says F-R-E-E and got rejected
Why can't I use exclamation marks in my ad?
My ad with special characters was disapproved
I used currency symbols in my headline and my ad got taken down

intents.label: Ad Disapproved — Vague Ad Copy
intents.description: Advertiser's ad was disapproved because the ad text is too generic and does not describe the actual product or service.
example_phrases: I wrote buy great products here and it got rejected
My headline says Shop now for deals and was disapproved
Why is my ad too generic?
My ad keeps getting rejected for being vague

intents.label: Ad Disapproved — Broken or Unavailable Landing Page
intents.description: Ad was approved previously but is now disapproved because the destination URL is returning an error, the site is down, or the page is under construction.
example_phrases: My ad was approved last week but now it's disapproved and I haven't changed anything
My landing page is fine but my ad is rejected
Why did my ad get disapproved overnight?
My ad status changed to disapproved without any changes from my side
intents.escalation_condition: Advertiser confirms site is live and URL is correct

intents.label: Ad Disapproved — Disabled Back Button on Landing Page
intents.description: Ad disapproved because the landing page has JavaScript or other code that prevents users from navigating back using the browser back button.
example_phrases: My competitor's ads are running fine but mine keep getting rejected
I can't figure out why my landing page is causing disapprovals
My ads are rejected but the page looks normal to me
What is wrong with my landing page?

intents.label: Ad Disapproved — Language Targeting Mismatch
intents.description: Ad or landing page content is in a different language than the targeting settings, violating technical requirements.
example_phrases: We're targeting Spanish speakers but our ads are in English, is that allowed?
My ads are in French but I'm targeting English speakers
Does the ad language have to match the targeting language?
We run multilingual campaigns, what are the language rules?

intents.label: Ad Disapproved — HTML5 Ad Malfunction
intents.description: HTML5 display ad renders incorrectly or appears blank in certain environments, typically mobile browsers.
example_phrases: My HTML5 banner shows fine on desktop but appears blank on mobile
My animated ad is not displaying properly
My HTML5 ad is blank on some devices
Display ad works on Chrome but not on Safari
intents.escalation_condition: Always — technical debugging required beyond policy clarification

intents.label: Ad Disapproved — Character or File Limit Exceeded
intents.description: Ad disapproved because the headline, body, image, or video asset exceeds the format-specific character count, file size, or length limits.
example_phrases: My headline is too long according to Google
My image ad was rejected for file size
What is the character limit for ad headlines?
My video ad was disapproved for length

intents.label: General Policy Clarification — Editorial or Technical
intents.description: Advertiser is asking a general question about editorial or technical policy without a specific disapproval event.
example_phrases: What are the rules for ad text formatting?
What technical requirements do my ads need to meet?
Can you explain Google Ads editorial standards?
What makes an ad compliant with Google policies?
